tools.name: state_verify
tools.description:
Compare a snapshot with its manifest (--snapshot), the state with a snapshot (--snapshot --db or --against) or with another database (--other-engine, --other-connection with secret references, or --against a settings file); names the table and rows that differ. [Target read-only] Usage: state verify --snapshot [--db] | --against | --other-engine sqlite|mssql|postgres [--other-connection ] [--other-sqlite ] [--other-schema ] [--other-prefix

] [--rehash-payloads] [--repo ]

args.description: The words and options after the command, one per element, as in the usage line.

tools.name: state_show
tools.description: Show the effective engine, the connection (secrets masked), where each module's tables are, each module's version in the registry and what is pending; read-only, creates and migrates nothing. [Target read-only] Usage: state show [--offline] [--repo <data directory>]

args.description: The words and options after the command, one per element, as in the usage line.

tools.name: state_test
tools.description: Connect, read the registry, check the rights and the engine version, and look for a schema clash and for migrations this login may not apply; stops at the first failure with the fix. [Target read-only] Usage: state test [--repo <data directory>]

args.description: The words and options after the command, one per element, as in the usage line.

tools.name: state_grants
tools.description: Print the GRANT statements a login needs for the gateway's modules (the login it runs as, or with --migrate the one that upgrades the database); run them as a database administrator. [Offline only] Usage: state grants --login <database role or user> [--migrate] [--repo <data directory>]

args.description: The words and options after the command, one per element, as in the usage line.

tools.name: semantic_describe
tools.description: What the model offers: its dimensions, attributes, measures, hierarchies and saved queries. [Offline only] Usage: semantic describe <model> [--address URL] --user U [--insecure]   (the password is DBDATAKIT_GATEWAY_PASSWORD)

args.description: The words and options after the command, one per element, as in the usage line.

tools.name: semantic_query
tools.description: Run a semantic query: semantic SQL (--sql) or a request (--request, JSON); the answer is read as the caller, at most --max-rows rows. [Offline only] Usage: semantic query <model> (--sql "..." | --request '{...}') [--max-rows N] [--address URL] --user U [--insecure]   (the password is DBDATAKIT_GATEWAY_PASSWORD)

args.description: The words and options after the command, one per element, as in the usage line.

tools.name: semantic_explain
tools.description: What a query would run on the sources, one row per scan, without running it. [Offline only] Usage: semantic explain <model> (--sql "..." | --request '{...}') [--address URL] --user U [--insecure]   (the password is DBDATAKIT_GATEWAY_PASSWORD)

args.description: The words and options after the command, one per element, as in the usage line.
